notes.title: DOESN'T REQUIRE VR DEVICES
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

Last update of Stealth Labyrinth ensure that the game NOT require any VR devices. 

This game can be played both VR and NOT VR: for VR players it support Vive and Oculus (dk2 and CV1).

Keyboard/Mouse and xbox controller are supported for both modes.

Thanks for checking out the game and have fun!

notes.title: Stealth Labyrinth is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks for your interest in Stealth Labyrinth, if you have any questions about the game, be sure to get in touch on the discussions threads in the Community Hub! We're eager to hear from you!

We have received a couple of common questions so we'll answer them here for you.

Q) Is this JUST a VR game? Can I play without a VR headset?
A) Yes you can play without VR! Just run the game, if you have a VR headset plugged in, it will play in VR mode, if not, it will play like any other traditional game.

Q) How much will this cost?
A) Since we want everyone to enjoy the VR experience, we have decided to offer the game at a low price to open up entry to all. The game will cost $2.99 or your regional equivalent.

Thanks for checking out the game and have fun!
